gates.name: Frames looked at (freelook/, 16 + contact sheet)
gates.value: 3P: body and gun keep facing the dummies while the camera looks 90 deg right, up 30, and around while running and sprinting; holstered the same; V: the eye turns, the FP gun and arms stay on the aim (the gun leaves the view at 90 deg); wall: the camera stops at the wall behind it, no clipping; the ADS frame with Alt held shows the normal sights

decisions: Alt is ignored during ADS, shoulder aim and while RMB is down; an RMB press during free look ends it (the camera snaps to the aim) and aims as before; a new Alt press is needed after aiming.
Release snaps back in one frame (FreeLookReturnTime 0, as in PUBG); an eased return is a property.
First person: the eye turns in place and the FP gun and arms stay on the aim (they leave the view when looking far to the side), so the screen never shows the gun pointing where the shots do not go.
Limits: yaw offset +-170, pitch offset -60..+60, looked-at view -75..+75; the crosshair hides beyond 2 deg off the aim.
method: C++ UNinjaGunComponent: FreeLookAction binding; ProcessGunViewRotation moves the look delta into FreeLookOffset before the recoil code; ModifyGunCamera stores the aim view, then ApplyFreeLook orbits (3P, ECC_Camera sweep from the pivot) or turns (FP) the POV; the HUD hides the crosshair. Content via build_gun_freelook_g10e.py (commandlet, /Game/Guns only). Probe g10_freelook_probe.py (-game, read-only; look input through AddYawInput / AddPitchInput so it passes ProcessViewRotation; real keys via Input.+key). Play test x3 + g9.
honest_notes: Python cannot call APawn::GetPawnViewLocation; the probe uses the actor location + BaseEyeHeight (the same for ACharacter).

In V with the camera turned 30 deg, the FP gun is drawn with the first-person scale (0.6), which squashes along the turned view axis, so the off-axis gun and forearm look a little large (fl09_fp_freelook_yaw30). It points correctly at the aim.
Pitching the free look up moves the orbiting camera down towards the floor (swept, so it never goes through it), which gives a low angle (fl03).
HighResShot frames do not include the canvas HUD; the crosshair check uses two lower-resolution "shot showui" frames (fl01u, fl02u).
Multiplayer: shots are built on the client from the aim view (unchanged); the server side was not exercised (single-player prototype).
BP_NinjaGasp_Gun is not given FreeLookAction; Left Alt there stays with the ninja free look (IA_GunFreeLook does not consume input).
One play-test run was invalidated by this session committing mid-run (F15 repo snapshot); it was re-run on the same binaries: 15/15.
